speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any drooping of your eyelids or double vision that worsens later in the day or after prolonged use? I also need to know if your weakness fluctuates throughout the day.

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any difficulty swallowing or speaking, and do you notice your symptoms fluctuating throughout the day? I will now order an acetylcholine receptor antibody test and a repetitive nerve stimulation study. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of acetylcholine receptor antibodies confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
